posts.t:
Hi Mike,

I made some comments on some charts. First, I would always be aware of the FO and use that to decide how to place my stop. Second, I think the engulf you traded was good enough to get back down to the area of the previous engulf you used as your signal, but only when the lower engulf had happened could you be sure price was going to move down further. The FO was just a nice place to grab more orders to sell against, which is a key confluence of the potential move further down.

Just my view - just an opinion.

dM

MF

Good morning,

A chart to begin the day

The first chart I saw a CP area, I also marked the supply that needed to be engulfed to gain access to the zone, something I noticed above was the nice-looking FTR, I love these kind of bases, I guess this comes from studying S Seiden's material for quite some time... As we can see from the chart below, that supply did get engulfed, price came back to the SR and formed an FTR, I know the base of this FTR is very average, however we go down a few TFs we can see an adequate base form for a trade I think, and look where price went to from the FTB, straight to the next FTR, beautiful.

If anyone has any comments on my charting, anything I am doing wrong, it would be great to know.

I know this is a thread for engulfs, I just wanted to show something I found very interesting regarding FTRs...

First chart is the 4hr, I noticed this small compact FTR, bear in mind though for those who get confused with the FTR is a FL thing and FL is an FTR etc... If one was to look on the daily I believe this would be one big FL, but on the 4hr it appears to me as an FTR...

Down to the hourly, I have left the 4hr zone in place, details on chart:

Next up is the 15 min chart, all zones have been left intact an we have now narrowed our risk down finding another FTR supply base (Green)

Next up is the 5 minute, I saw this nice-looking FTR zone and marked it with blue, bear in mind all these zones are within the overall larger 4hr zone.

And here is what happened, near enough to the pip, what a great trade that would have been to take...

This was only an experiment, I am not saying a correct one either:) or that I would have been brave enough to take this trade, take this post as purely educational...

Thanks

DT
